scope: Fresh read-only static analysis of selected installed official-client ordinary native branches: Rune and Relic preprocessing, SP configuration and queries, duration and Blackboard operations. No game execution, tests or runtime XLua override verification.

tool.writePolicy: Only this new evidence JSON is written by this extraction; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 is set. Native.enum_values is not used.

evidenceBoundary: The checked Rune cost operations execute sequentially in a priority queue. CSkillCdAdd inherits priority 500; CSkillCdMul has priority 501. Each individual operation rounds its current cost to an even integer.

The checked Roguelike cost multiplication executes once per qualified Relic preprocessing callback over the current skill data and rounds each result. It does not first aggregate all scales into a single product.
These preprocessing and explicit parameter operations do not establish the same combination formula for a persistent pure Skill contribution query.

The project chooses the existing attribute.Modifier data and its reduction as a policy for the pure contribution API. That project policy is not asserted to reproduce the Rune or Relic preprocessing paths recorded here; their multiple-step rounding is outside this implementation scope.
XLua delegate branches are preserved in the disassembly. Runtime delegate installation and replacement bodies are unverified.
The retained duration and Blackboard methods are direct native evidence; no additional scalar aggregation rule is inferred from method names.
